note: The Available Forces ledger (#159, spec #157), authored from study B · Libro. Rectangles are [x, y, width, height]: FigCraft absoluteBounds of the frame '16:9 available forces', in frame units, which are pixels of the owner's 3840x2160 display; one reference pixel is 1.6875 units. The ledger is anchored top right, as the main view's area 'available-forces' is: every part keeps its distance from the window's top and right edges. 'parts' are drawn images: the plate (panel and rules, exported from the group 'plate'), the victory emblems (atlas-victory-icon-*.png) and the nine G1 pieces (atlas-available-*.png, VectorCraft). 'text' are runtime Lato boxes with the frame's example values: the caption (Ledger/caption: Bold 24, 3 tracking, centred, ink-secondary) and the counts (Ledger/count: Regular 43.875, ink), each count a fixed 56-wide box left-aligned beside its piece. 'zero' is the frame 'zero state': a kind with none left keeps its cell and draws its piece at this opacity beside '0'.

tag.note: #160: a faction's tag. 'rows' are the hover and focus targets in the frame '16:9 available forces' (hidden rectangles '<faction>-row'): each row's band across the plate, between the rules around it. 'frame' is the FigCraft frame 'hover tag · Government', the accepted top-display tag (TOP.md) at 1.6875 units per reference pixel: 'parts' and 'text' are relative to its top left; the plate is atlas-top-tag.png stretched to the tag and the rule atlas-victory-rule.png; text styles Tag/title (Lato 45.5625, ink), Tag/row (30.375; labels ink, values ink-secondary) and Tag/note (28.6875, 38.8125 per line, ink-secondary). The tag grows with its rows and note lines as the top-display tag does: rows from 128.25, 47.25 apart; notes 20.25 below the rows; 23.625 below the notes. 'open' is where every faction's tag opens (the hidden 'government-tag' in the 16:9 frame): 13.5 left of the ledger, its top 13.5 below the standings area's foot, anchored top right. 'export' is the frame's export, for review; it is not admitted.
